graft.title: Hub worker worktrees on Windows can't be opened from WSL, so a Nix project's checks can't run there
graft.need: A hub worker's worktree on Windows (here C:/Users/Vaibhav/AppData/Roaming/tend/hub/worktrees/vg-dotfiles-hookspath-91bc4b57c739) has a `.git` file whose gitdir is an absolute Windows path (C:/vg-dotfiles/.git/worktrees/...). A check run through WSL (`wsl -d NixOS -- bash nix/scripts/check-hosts.sh`, from impl_score run) sees the folder as /mnt/c/..., and nix's libgit2 fails: `opening Git repository "/mnt/c/.../vg-dotfiles-hookspath-91bc4b57c739": failed to resolve path 'C:/vg-dotfiles/.git/worktrees/vg-dotfiles-hookspath-91bc4b57c739'` (2026-11-16). So no Nix evaluation can run in a hub worker's worktree on Windows. Asked: create worker worktrees with relative paths (git 2.48+: `git worktree add --relative-paths`, or `worktree.useRelativePaths=true`), so the gitdir resolves from both Windows and WSL; or else say in the worker's brief that WSL checks can't run in its worktree.
graft.use_case: vg-dotfiles' checks are Nix evaluations and builds that run on Windows only through NixOS-WSL. A hub worker dispatched to change Nix code can't verify anything it changes, so its grafts stay open until the user reruns the checks from the main checkout.
